* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image of 7 August 2025<ref name="ht-cs-0">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/7821822/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Light/large/courageofaskywalker.gif courageofaskywalker.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/7821822 7821822] (7 August 2025).</ref>, no errata mark.  Text: “If a [Skywalker] Effect on table, destiny +2 when drawn for destiny. Take a lightsaber into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle. OR Retrieve Anakin's Lightsaber. OR Once per game, during a battle or duel involving a Skywalker and a Dark Jedi, make a just drawn destiny = 2.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Courage Of A Skywalker (V) (Errata)]]): PC card image of 9 March 2026<ref name="ht-cs-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6f23e07/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Light/large/courageofaskywalker.gif courageofaskywalker.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6f23e07 6f23e07] (9 March 2026).</ref>, marked “E1”. What changed from the previous image: PC Tweak Set errata (marked “E1”): the whole text is replaced. “If a [Skywalker] Effect on table, destiny +2 when drawn for destiny.” and “Take a lightsaber into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle. OR Retrieve Anakin's Lightsaber.” become “If your Skywalker in battle alone with a character of greater ability, add one battle destiny. OR Deploy a lightsaber on a Skywalker from Lost Pile (or Force Pile; reshuffle).”; the last option drops “and a Dark Jedi”. Text: “If your Skywalker in battle alone with a character of greater ability, add one battle destiny. OR Deploy a lightsaber on a Skywalker from Lost Pile (or Force Pile; reshuffle). OR Once per game, during a battle or duel involving a Skywalker, make a just drawn destiny = 2.”
Versions follow Bill's ruling of 12 November 2026: every visible change on a PC card image is a version (the PC's own E marks count only its announced errata).
